core_obligations: Derive exactness of i_* from the pushforward exactness lemma and Sites closed-immersion.
Transfer full faithfulness from sheaves of sets and prove module-linearity via the displayed rectangle and surjectivity of i^sharp.
Realize a module G with IG = 0 as i_*F via the closed-subtopos characterization and set-level surjectivity.
Define the module structure on F from the O'-action on G annihilating I and conclude i_*F = G.
proof_roadmap: exactness citation + fully-faithful transfer via surjectivity + essential image via subtopos and structure transport
difficulty_reason: Full chain executed: exactness of i_* from the delivered pushforward exactness lemma plus Sites closed-immersion; fully faithfulness transferred from sheaves of sets, with O'-linearity of the recovered map proven via the displayed two-row commutative rectangle and surjectivity of i^sharp; essential image: annihilation is immediate, and conversely a module G with IG = 0 is realized as i_*F using the closed-subtopos characterization (subsheaf U of the final object), set-level surjectivity of i_*, and transport of the addition and multiplication structures through the given O'-action which kills I (i_*O = O'/I).
